title: Higgsfield Pricing Explained: Plans, Credits, and What’s Included
snippet:
Higgsfield pricing is a monthly subscription that gives you credits: Starter includes 200 credits a month, Plus 1,000, and Ultra 3,000. Team plans add credits per seat. Every generation costs credits, and the cost depends on the model, the clip length, and the resolution.

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Credits per month** | **Models** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | Not included | A limited set |
| Starter | $15/month | 200 | Selected models |
| Plus | $49/month | 1,000 | Every model |
| Ultra | $129/month | 3,000 | Every model |

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Credits per month** | **Members** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Team | $79 per seat/month | 1,000 per seat | 2 to 9 |
| Scale | $215 per seat/month | 2,500 per seat | 5 to 15 |
You can pay monthly or annually. Annual plans include more 7-day Unlimited models (see below). Paid plans include commercial use.

## Does Higgsfield Have a Free Plan?
Higgsfield has a free plan, and every new account starts on it at no cost. The free plan opens a limited set of models, runs one generation at a time, and doesn’t include monthly credits. Generations on open models still deduct credits, and they can carry a visible Higgsfield watermark.
The models open on the free plan are marked in the Free column of the comparison table on the Pricing page, for example Nano Banana Pro and FLUX.2 Pro.
A paid plan is required for:
- Monthly credits and Credit Packs
- Unlimited models
- Soul ID characters
- Fast-track generation and early access to new models
- Start & End Frame control, Higgsfield Speak, and UGC builder
New generations on the free plan are private by default, and you can publish any of them yourself. When a paid subscription ends, the account moves to the free plan, and everything in Assets stays in place

*Credit costs taken from the Higgsfield pricing page and interface in October 2026. Dollar estimates use the Plus monthly rate ($49 for 1,000 credits, ≈$0.049 per credit).*

title: Meet the Higgsfield API: How It Works and What You Get
snippet:
The Higgsfield API is a self-serve API for developers that provides direct access to more than 50 current video and image generation models with pay-as-you-go billing in US dollars. There is no subscription: you top up a balance, pay per generation at published rates, and spending stops automatically at zero.

The Higgsfield API gives developers programmatic access to a curated catalog of video and image generation models. If you are building a product that generates video or images, you normally assemble model access from several providers, each with its own billing logic, expiration rules, and rate structures. Estimating what a month of production traffic will cost becomes a separate task. The Higgsfield API is built around a different setup: one key, one balance in US dollars, and a public price list, so you can calculate your costs on your own volume before you commit to anything.
The API is a separate product from the [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai) website. A plan on [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai) does not affect API access, and API usage is billed independently.

Setting up access takes four steps:
1. Create an account and choose between personal and company use.
2. Add a payment method and top up your balance.
3. Create your first API key. The key is shown once at creation, so store it securely. Creating a key unlocks 20 concurrent requests.
4. Integrate using the Python or TypeScript SDK, or call the REST API directly from any language with an HTTP client. Each model page includes ready code samples, plus prepared setup prompts for Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT (Codex) that configure the integration from a single instruction.

The Higgsfield API is billed in US dollars per generation, with no subscription at any level. The billing model follows five principles:
- **Billing is per request.** You add a payment method, top up a balance, and each generation deducts its cost from the balance. Access does not require a plan or a seat fee.
- **The balance is held in US dollars.** Every price is listed in dollars as well, so the rate on the pricing page is the rate you pay.
- **Prices are public.** Every model's rate is listed openly: video models are priced per second of output, image models per image.
- **Self-serve pricing follows the published model rates.** The price per generation is the rate on the pricing page, at any top-up amount.

title: Higgsfield AI Pricing: Plans, API Costs and Is It Free?
snippet:
Since 2026 Higgsfield also sells a developer API that bills each generation in dollars, with no subscription[1][2].

- **Free:** there is a Free tier for limited use, but no plan with free monthly credits. The API's launch offer gives $15 of balance after you verify a business email and add a card[1][2].

| Plan | Price per month | Credits per month | Cost per credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $19 | 270 | about $0.070 |
| Plus | $47 billed annually, $59 monthly | 1,200 | about $0.039 annually |
| Ultra | $99 billed annually, $129 monthly | 3,000 | about $0.033 annually |

The Higgsfield API is a separate product for developers. It bills each successful generation from a prepaid balance, lists a price for every model, and has no subscription or seat fee[2]. Requests that fail or are blocked by moderation are not charged, credits expire one year after they are added, and output files are kept for at least seven days[5].
Most API prices on October 5, 2026 carried a launch discount. Higgsfield says new accounts get 15% off sale models and can pick three models for discounts of up to 75%[2]. For Seedance, its price list showed rates 30% below list price and marked 30% as the maximum discount for those models, so the figures below are the lowest Seedance price it offered[3].

### Is Higgsfield AI free?
Not in the sense of a free monthly allowance. The pricing page shows a Free tier for limited use, and paid plans include some free generations on selected models, but credits come with Starter, Plus or Ultra[1]. The API has no free tier either; its launch offer adds $15 of balance once you verify a business email and add a card[2]. On reAPI, eligible new accounts may receive promotional test credits, with no card required.

### Is the Higgsfield API free?
No. The playground is free to try, but every generation through the API is billed from your balance. The $15 launch credit is the only free amount it describes[2].
